landmarks.name: Maiden Tower
landmarks.writeup: A 12th-century monument in Baku's Old City, symbolizing Azerbaijan's rich history and architecture.

landmarks.name: Gobustan Rock Art Cultural Landscape
landmarks.writeup: An archaeological site featuring ancient petroglyphs dating back 5,000 to 40,000 years.

landmarks.name: Heydar Aliyev Center
landmarks.writeup: A modern architectural landmark in Baku designed by Zaha Hadid, known for its flowing, curved style.

cultural_events.name: Novruz Bayram
cultural_events.writeup: A traditional celebration of the Persian New Year marking the arrival of spring with various rituals and festivities.

cultural_events.name: Baku International Jazz Festival
cultural_events.writeup: An annual event attracting international jazz artists, celebrating Azerbaijan's jazz heritage.

food_writeup: Azerbaijani cuisine features diverse dishes with influences from Middle Eastern, Eastern European, and Mediterranean cuisines, known for kebabs, plov (rice pilaf), dolma, and rich use of herbs and spices.
brief_history: Azerbaijan has a history dating back to ancient times, influenced by Persian, Turkish, and Russian empires. It became a Soviet republic in 1920 and gained independence in 1991 after the USSR's dissolution.

important_people.name: Heydar Aliyev
important_people.description: Former president and influential political leader.

current_conflicts: Ongoing tensions and intermittent clashes with Armenia over the Nagorno-Karabakh region, a disputed territory internationally recognized as part of Azerbaijan but with a majority ethnic Armenian population.
